prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One isolated realistic modular chain-link security fence panel for a harbor race circuit. 4 meters wide and 2.4 meters high. Galvanized tubular steel rectangular frame with two vertical end posts and flat bolted mounting feet, top and bottom horizontal rails. Interior filled by regular open diamond-pattern woven chain-link metal wire, each diamond visibly see-through to the plain light gray background. Moderate diamond pitch approximately 12 centimeters, robust visible wire. Realistic zinc surface with restrained oxidation at joints. Almost frontal three-quarter view with slight angle to reveal thickness, entire silhouette visible. No wall, no ground, no barbed wire, no text or props. Neutral diffuse studio lighting.
